law: Allusion-grade only: places, foods, rituals as comedy material. Never reproduce lyrics or routines. Map each use to doctrine + unit.

entries.angle: Hot wings at 2am after the motive dies. Desire, immediate and specific.
The sacred pilgrimage oftness; PERiometer as merit index.
Steak bake eschatology: the best things are 90p and gone by noon.
Main + snack + drink, fixed price: karma economy, merit accounting.
Boxfresh hierarchy; identity you can buy, weekly drop dharma.
Tourist-trap twin of JD; wanting as window shopping.
Trim the self, emerge a new man; anatta with hot towels.
Everything costs nothing and falls apart: impermanence, high street edition.
The sacred/profane axis in one building; desire with a dress code.
Harrods inverted; same grasping, smaller receipt.
Bardo transit: between states, fluorescent-lit, nobody's home.
Merit deducted per journey; the gate always knows your balance.
The teaching, announced every 3 minutes, ignored by millions.
Borrowed vehicle, returned dented: the body.
Collective effervescence; joy that needs no owner.
Smoke contemplation; watching things dissolve socially.
Samsara with bibs; same game, different suffering.
Craving with a spin button; merit burned at 20-second intervals.
The real sangha meets where the cameras don't.

entries.place: Balcony over the ends at dusk
entries.angle: Surveying your whole realm; king of two postcodes.

entries.place: Grey sky that never quite rains
